Conclusion:

The test `['test.server_test.MetricsHandlerTest.test_get()']` checks whether the `_metrics_collector.configure_http_handler` method is called once in the `MetricsHandler.get()` method. However, the AssertionError indicates that this method was not called at all during the execution of the test. Upon inspecting the code snippet for the `MetricsCollector.__init__` method using the `get_code_snippet(signature=luigi.metrics.MetricsCollector.__init__)` function call, we find that it does nothing and simply passes without initializing any members or attributes that might be used in configuring an HTTP handler. Consequently, when `self.mock_scheduler._state._metrics_collector` is initialized with the `MetricsCollector`, no configuration for the HTTP handler occurs, leading to the failure of the assertion check.

Suggestions for fix:

```
luigi.metrics.MetricsHandler.__init__(self)
luigi.metrics.MetricsCollector.configure_http_handler(self.handler)
```
